# Searqon

> Evidence-first open-source toolkit for assessing AI discoverability and agent readiness across SEO, AEO, GEO and AgEO.

Searqon by Tinlance analyzes local HTML, Markdown, OpenAPI documents, caller-supplied MCP snapshots, caller-supplied GEO observations and one explicitly authorized public web page. It produces evidence-linked, versioned assessment data and optional standalone HTML reports.

## Project status

- Maturity: early alpha; not production-ready.
- Runtime: Node.js 22 or later.
- Implementation: JavaScript ES modules; package name `@tinlance/searqon`.
- License: Apache-2.0.
- Current package version in package.json: 0.2.0.
- Runtime dependencies: none currently declared.

## Current commands

```bash
node src/cli.js scan ./examples/site.html
node src/cli.js scan ./examples/openapi.json
node src/cli.js scan ./examples/mcp-snapshot.json --format mcp
node src/cli.js scan-url https://example.com/docs --confirm-authorized-target
node src/cli.js geo analyze ./examples/geo-observation.json
node src/cli.js geo aggregate ./examples/geo-observations.json
node src/cli.js report ./assessment.json --out ./assessment.html
```

## Important capability boundaries

- Remote scanning is limited to one selected public page; it does not recursively crawl or render browser JavaScript.
- Remote scanning requires an explicit operator authorization attestation. Cross-origin redirect destinations require explicit origin allowlisting.
- MCP analysis is passive and accepts a local snapshot; Searqon does not connect to an MCP server or invoke tools.
- GEO commands analyze supplied observations; there are no live provider adapters, consumer-interface scrapers, scheduler or historical monitoring store.
- The local evidence ledger is hash-linked but is not encrypted, multi-process safe, remotely replicated or WORM-immutable.
- Searqon does not guarantee rankings, AI citations, recommendations or agent adoption. AgEO is a proposed Searqon discipline, not a universal standard.
